overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing a non-qualifying topic (service restoration after Tropical Storm Irene) in executive session on September 13, 2011, and ordered future compliance and public release of that minutes portion.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission discussed a topic in its September 13, 2011 executive session that was not listed in the notice or announced in open session.
allegations.key_passage: This topic was not appropriate for executive session, as it did not fit within any of the ten enumerated purposes for executive session.

allegations.summary: Related to the same September 13, 2011 executive session: whether the chair stated the executive session purpose and the Purpose 6 detrimental-effect declaration before entering.
allegations.key_passage: it appears that the chair did not specifically state this purpose prior to entering the executive session

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (ordered).

Publicly release the portion of the September 13, 2011 executive session minutes discussing the Tispaquin Family Campground service restoration, if not already done, unless attorney/client privilege or a Public Records Law exemption applies.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Commission that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the law. Additionally, we order the Commission to publicly release this portion of the minutes from its September 13, 2011 executive session
